page: Google Cloud Platform n4-highcpu-2 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the n4 server family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor, consisting of 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, and it offers zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The processor features a cache hierarchy of 48 KB L1d, 2 MB L2, and 260 MB L3 cache, alongside support for advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions.

Benchmark data indicates that the n4-highcpu-2 delivers moderate single-core performance but exhibits limitations under multi-threaded and memory-intensive workloads. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU performance is rated as average with a score of 1657.98, whereas multi-core performance falls into the poor category at 1736.79. Similarly, Geekbench results show an average single-core score of 1836.0, contrasted with a weak multi-core score of 2242.0. Memory bandwidth is a notable bottleneck, with large-block read and write speeds of 17.81 GB/sec and 11.0 GB/sec respectively, both categorized as poor. Passmark database operations and software compilation benchmarks also register in the poor range, reflecting the resource constraints of a 2-vCPU configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the n4-highcpu-2 represents an entry-level compute-optimized tier suitable for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation but have low memory and storage demands. Due to its low memory capacity of 4.0 GB and weak multi-core scaling, it is poorly suited for database hosting, heavy compilation, or complex multi-threaded applications. However, its average single-core performance and support for advanced vector and matrix instructions make it viable for lightweight single-threaded tasks, basic text processing, simple web serving, and low-intensity utility scripts.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4-highcpu-2 is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel processor with 1 physical core and 2 threads, it includes 260 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX. The instance does not include bundled local storage or GPUs. Performance benchmarks show average single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1836.0 and stress-ng single-core score of 1657.98. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth are weak to poor, with large-block memory read speeds limited to 17.81 GB/sec. Given these constraints, the n4-highcpu-2 is qualitatively cost-effective for lightweight, single-threaded workloads, basic text processing, and simple web serving, but is not recommended for memory-intensive database operations or heavy multi-threaded compilation.
